name: Valerie Wong
source:
As the daughter of a Chinese man who moved to America with nothing but hopes and determination, Valerie was born with a strong will and a certain degree of idealism. This personality mixed with her perfectionist tendencies results in Valerie working extremely hard for what she wants, no matter how far away the goal may seem. Her ability to see red strings of fate has also caused her to believe in soulmates, which has ironically led her to close her heart off, saving it for her soulmate. She will do whatever it takes to find him, even if it means working four part time jobs to save up for the money to travel around the world for her search.
